transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
I'm here today because I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and empty inside for about a year and two months now. I just don't have any energy or motivation to do anything anymore.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, hyperactive, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never felt that way at all. I've mostly just felt completely exhausted, down, and low on energy instead. It has been like this the whole time.
During this time, have you ever heard voices, seen things that others couldn't see, or had strong beliefs that others found unusual or hard to believe?

Yes, since I've been depressed, I've started hearing whispering voices and seeing shadowy figures when no one is actually there. I've also had this overwhelming feeling that I'm being monitored by some organization, and that random events on the street are secret signs meant just for me.

Yes, those experiences only happen when I am feeling deeply depressed. I've never had them during times when my mood was relatively okay or before this depression started. They seem completely tied to how down I am feeling.
Have you also been experiencing strong feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or any thoughts of wanting to end your life during this time?

No, I haven't really experienced those feelings of worthlessness or guilt. I also haven't had any thoughts of wanting to end my life. It is more just a constant sense of emptiness and being completely drained.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns or your appetite since you started feeling this way?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my sleep or appetite. They both seem to have remained relatively normal and unchanged.
Have you found it harder to focus, concentrate, or make simple daily decisions since you've been feeling this way?

Yes, I've been struggling a lot with both. I find it nearly impossible to concentrate on simple tasks like reading or watching TV. Even making minor daily choices, like what to wear or eat, has become extremely difficult and causes me to hesitate constantly.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things you used to enjoy, even the small things?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to love. I don't feel any pleasure, satisfaction, or happiness from doing them anymore. Everything just feels completely flat and empty now.
Have you or those close to you noticed that you are moving, thinking, or speaking much more slowly than usual, or conversely, that you feel unusually restless and unable to sit still?

I haven't really noticed being unusually restless or moving and speaking noticeably slower. However, my body constantly feels completely physically exhausted, and my thinking often feels very foggy and dazed.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a major depressive episode lasting 14 months, characterized by depressed mood, anhedonia, fatigue, and impaired concentration. During this depressive episode, they also experienced congruent psychotic symptoms (hallucinations and persecutory delusions). Since the psychotic symptoms occur exclusively during the mood episodes, Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features is the most accurate diagnosis, ruling out Schizoaffective Disorder.
